digest.component_or_area: Jira family adapter subsystem (Cloud and Data Center backends)
propositions: rebar cannot reconcile against self-hosted Jira Data Center due to REST v2 protocol, wiki-markup bodies, PAT bearer auth, and name-based user identity differing from Cloud's REST v3 ADF, accountId, and ACLI subprocess auth
PR#120's separate adapter duplicates private field-mapping logic and value dictionaries across two backend packages, creating an unsupported shared library with no contract and drift risk
The status and priority value maps are already duplicated across three locations (jira_fields, outbound_fields pinned, config.py) and have already drifted on the deleted key

A shared Jira-family seam must consolidate duplicated mapping logic and value dictionaries into one implementation imported by both backends, while parameterizing divergent axes (rich-text codec for ADF vs wiki markup, user identity model for accountId vs name)

Data Center connection requires TLS enforcement with operator-configurable certificate bundles, explicit allow_insecure override with warnings, PAT env-only credential handling, and least-privilege service-account scope documentation

The Cloud adapter's observable behavior and dynamic-loader path pinning must remain unchanged; location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) cannot relocate, and their contents must be re-pointed to shared contracts via dependency inversion rather than moving
